subject: Post-demo committee synthesis, decision risks, and proposed next sprints
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11 09:12 -07:00
Subject: Post-demo committee synthesis, decision risks, and proposed next sprints

Hi Liam — thanks again for running the demo with the committee this morning. I wanted to capture the thread-level synthesis and make the asks explicit so we keep momentum. Notes below from our call and suggested next steps.

Who we heard and their likely roles (as I captured):
- You (Liam) — economic buyer, drive on ROI and procurement cadence
- Dr. Ana Morales — clinical exec, outcome/clinical-risk owner
- Priya (security) — security/data residency gate
- Sara (procurement) — procurement timeline and contract owner

Key decision criteria called out by the group:
1) Quantifiable per-patient latency and cost (baseline + 3 sample workloads)
2) Data handling / isolation (VPC or private deployment options)
3) SOC2 / encryption / audit logs (audit trail requirements)
4) SLA and rollback/fallback policies for peak hours

Immediate asks / proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- We: send a short MAP doc + preliminary pricing and a filled security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow (attached: MAP_draft.pdf, security-questions.xlsx).
- You: confirm procurement timeline and whether you need a vendor-risk-form or PO language (copy procurement@healthai.com).
- Suggested checkpoint: 30-minute follow-up w/ procurement + security on Apr 18 to align on contractual gates and timelines.

Open risks I want to call out proactively:
- If procurement requires an on-prem/on-VPC-only deployment, that will impact estimated TCO and delivery timeline.
- If the committee requires a dedicated capacity SLA from Day 1, pricing/commit terms will change.

Next steps I recommend from our side: we’ll share pricing tiers (including a test/dev tier and a committed-dedicated tier), the security questionnaire answers, and a one-page SOW sketch. Jordan will lead pricing and Ben will loop legal for baseline terms.

Attachments: MAP_draft.pdf, security-questions.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
(415) 555-0194

--
From the demo notes: "prefix cache and quantization profiles were highlighted as cost levers; Ana asked for clinical validation plan."
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@healthai.com>, procurement@healthai.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11 11:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo committee synthesis, decision risks, and proposed next sprints

Thanks Hannah — great summary and helpful to see the risks called out. Quick notes from my side:
- Confirm I am the economic buyer and will own budget approval (goal: decision by end of May).
- Procurement will need a single-sheet pricing summary + standard vendor-risk-form filled out. Can you include a near-term estimate for a 6-month pilot (3 test nodes, expected avg tokens/day) and a committed 12-month price for production?
- Security team (Priya) will want the SOC2 and an overview of audit log retention — is that in the security-questions.xlsx?

If you can get the MAP + pricing + filled questionnaire by tomorrow EOD that would help us schedule procurement review the week of Apr 24.

Cheers,
Liam
VP Product & Partnerships | HealthAI
liam.oneill@healthai.com

On Tue, Apr 11, 2028 at 09:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks again for running the demo with the committee this morning. I wanted to capture the thread-level synthesis and make the asks explicit so we keep momentum. Notes below from our call and suggested next steps.
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11 13:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo committee synthesis, decision risks, and proposed next sprints

Hannah — I’ll take point on pricing. Draft notes:
- Pilot pricing: time-limited trial credit + pay-as-you-go at dev tier; estimate below in a sheet.
- Production: recommend two-tier offer — reserved capacity (monthly commit) + burst usage.
- Discount: if they commit 12 months/annual upfront we can offer a 15% reserved discount, plus 60-day rollout credits for onboarding.

I won’t promise SLA beyond standard hosted SLA until we know whether they want Dedicated / Private. Ben, can you flag any key contract items we should avoid committing to in the one-pager?

—Jordan
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@healthai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthai.com>
Cc: procurement@healthai.com
Date: 2028-04-12 09:48 -07:00
Subject: Procurement intake & timeline (HealthAI)

Hi Hannah / Liam — looping in procurement as requested. A few items from our side so you can align deliverables: 
- Please provide:
  * Vendor risk form (attached) — completed and signed
  * Single-sheet pricing with volume tiers and any committed discount language
  * SOC2 report or SOC2 letter + data handling description
  * Sample SOW + lead times for a VPC/private deployment if needed
- Timeline: procurement review Apr 20, legal review Apr 25, exec sign-off the week of May 2 (approx). If you hit those gates we can aim for pilot start late May.

Questions:
1) Are there data residency options in region (we require EU/US segmentation for some workloads)?
2) Who will be the contract owner at Redwood for signature and invoicing?

Attached: vendor-risk-form.pdf

Thanks — please confirm you can deliver the items by Apr 13 EOD.

Best,
Sara Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager | HealthAI
sara.gomez@healthai.com
procurement@healthai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@healthai.com>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@healthai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12 16:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo committee synthesis, decision risks, and proposed next sprints

Liam / Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear timeline. We can hit the Apr 13 deliverable window for the MAP, single-sheet pricing, and the answered security questionnaire. Quick notes from our side: 
- Contract owner for Redwood: Ben Carter, Commercial Ops (ben_carter@redwood.com).
- Data residency: Redwood supports region pinning (US/EU/APAC) at deployment; we’ll note options in the SOW and call out any lead-time for on-prem if required.
- Attached a pricing spreadsheet (pricing-v1.xlsx) with pilot and committed tiers; Jordan and I will update if procurement requests different volume breakpoints.

Proposed next meeting: Apr 18, 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes with procurement + security to confirm gating items and SOW assumptions. If that works I’ll send the invite.

Action owners:
- Hannah: finalize MAP + security answers (due Apr 13 EOD)
- Jordan: finalize pricing tiers + apply pilot credits (due Apr 13 EOD)
- Ben: prepare baseline term sheet + send calendar invite for Apr 18

Thanks all — we’ll push the attachments to the shared link and to procurement directly.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
(650) 555-0108
